shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd
rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'SKILL.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*spec*' -g 'test-commands.yml' -g 'reanchor.mjs' | head -80
git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md
cat .lore/test-commands.yml"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md
command -v lore-query-trace || true
rg -n \"onError|afterSession|called with session and error|error still propagates\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,125p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,65p' CHANGELOG.md
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,125p' src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
rg -n \"onError|afterSession|error still propagates\" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:\" src/orchestration/*.test.ts | head -35
rg --files scripts/spec-links .lore 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/[a-z-]+/spec.md|specs/[a-z-]+#[0-9]+|spec:\" src scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -70
sed -n '270,370p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
sed -n '1,35p' CHANGELOG.md
ls node_modules/.bin/jest node_modules/.bin/prettier 2>/dev/null"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md|#6\\)|#7\\)\" src scripts | head -35
rg -n \"VALIDATED_BY|spec anchor|specs/.+#[0-9]+\" .lore scripts | head -50"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat
git diff -- src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md CHANGELOG.md
nl -ba src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts | head -12
timeout 300 node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --runInBand --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md
git diff --check
git status --short
git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/onErrorCause.test.ts
git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): report non-Error rejections"'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main
git status --short --branch'
